qualification: Block virtualizer diagnostics without synchronous UART RPC
observations: ARM UART output contains complete formatted READY, ATTACH, RAM disk and request-pump diagnostics after removing the virtualizer UART endpoint and transfer page.
The Ubuntu console gate serial log records host media 0 ready sectors=8127128 read-only, host-media read sector=0 count=8 client=0, and a request pumped via virtio_blk.
limitations: The x86 check links the actual virtualizer ELF; the Intel composition does not yet start it or attach a host block device.
The common logger has a release-silent debug fallback on x86; this receipt does not claim visible Intel virtualizer diagnostics.
Nameserver registration and host block Calls remain; only synchronous diagnostic dependencies were removed.
Writable persistence, final integration and the v0.4 release remain incomplete.
